versions.name: RXV2-0.9.434-nudge-manners
versions.notes: The back-up-your-tune reminder now has manners: completing a backup (from either the Backup page or Black box) signs off the current tune generation, so the banner goes away and STAYS away until a setting actually changes - then it returns after six unchanged flights, exactly as before.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.433-clocked-events
versions.notes: Two from Malcolm's bench log: (1) BUG FIX - with an arming channel known, the old 'link live 30s = flying' rule fought the new disarm revival, flapping the radios every 5 seconds on the bench with the transmitter on; ARMED is now the only definition of flying on such models (the old rule remains for models without arming). (2) The event log now shows the TIME OF DAY for every event once a phone has taught the receiver the clock - retroactively for events logged before the sync; time-since-boot before that.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.432-armed-banner
versions.notes: The loud goodbye: the moment arming comes on, every app page shows a full-screen red banner - 'ARMED! WiFi & Bluetooth are switching OFF for flying. The app disconnects in 3 seconds. Disarm the model to get it back.' The banner survives the disconnection (that IS the message) and clears when the link returns disarmed. Even the most enthusiastic, absent-minded pilot will notice.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.431-armed-lockout
versions.notes: Completing the crash response: the moment the model is ARMED with a live transmitter, ALL configuration traffic to the flight controller is refused instantly ('ARMED - configuration is locked in flight. Disarm first.') - closing the 3-second window before auto fly mode kills the radios, and every other path. The stall-starves-CRSF-and-the-motor-cuts mechanism is now impossible at both ends.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.430-autofly-locked
versions.notes: SAFETY (after the 2026-08-24 crash): with Rotorflight present, automatic fly mode is FORCED ON and cannot be switched off - flying with the config link alive lets a blocking config request starve the CRSF stream, which Rotorflight reads as signal loss and cuts the motor. The Receiver-settings switch shows a lock; non-Rotorflight models keep the choice.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.429-wire-step
versions.notes: Wizard's 'Wire it up & first contact' step no longer has an Open button that led oddly back to the menu - it is a check, not a page: proof of life is the Rotorflight config button appearing on the front screen by itself.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.428-fewer-words
versions.notes: Fewer words look clearer (Malcolm's doctrine, applied to the front screen): the automatic-fly-mode note line is gone (Receiver settings explains it), 'Bind' stands alone, 'Rotorflight config' drops the version number (it lives on the Rotorflight page), and 'Setup' loses its trailing list.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.427-steady-front
versions.notes: No more front-screen shuffle: the app remembers the last known layout (Fly now hidden? Rotorflight present, and which version?) and paints it instantly at launch, before the receiver has even answered. The live state then only repaints if something actually changed - so on a Rotorflight model the right buttons are simply there from the first frame.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.426-rescue-plain
versions.notes: 'Rescue switch' is now simply 'Rescue', for the same reason as Arming: it is a channel, and what drives it is the radio's business.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.425-arming-plain
versions.notes: 'Arming switch' is now simply 'Arming' - it is a channel, not necessarily a switch: some radios drive it from a safety switch or mix among other functions. (Malcolm's precision, gladly accepted.)

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.424-strict-channels
versions.notes: Strictly one channel per function now: taken channels vanish from every other dropdown (no sharing at all), existing double-bookings are repaired on load (the later claimant resets to 'Choose...', keeping its name), and the stick labels lose their bracketed words - just Aileron, Elevator, Collective, Rudder, Throttle.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.423-no-collisions
versions.notes: Two field-driven fixes on Transmitter channels: (1) taken channels are simply not offered in the other dropdowns any more (switch functions may still share with each other - only sticks and Arm are exclusive); (2) the Rescue switch can be removed entirely (X sets None and clears any saved rescue from the flight controller - some models just don't have one), and saving with Rescue=None also wipes a stale saved rescue.
